english.note: Use this as the everyday choice when the employer is also the person you work for or report to.
This is the everyday all-purpose choice when the entrepreneur owns and runs a business.
Use this for the person who owns or runs a shop or other retail business.
Use this especially for a business owner, employer, or shopkeeper rather than any workplace supervisor.
Use 老闆 when the chief is the boss of a business or workplace.

examples.english: My employer asked me to come to work early today.
examples.traditional: 我個老闆今日叫我早啲返工。
